selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What invites the traveller to continue his reflective journey in this passage?
questions.answer: The mountains and the plains call him to examine them and learn from what they show.

questions.question: How does the traveller react to the role of mountains?
questions.answer: He sees their purpose as so impressive and wise that it leaves the mind amazed.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the earth after the mountains rise up?
questions.answer: It becomes calmer and can continue its movement in a stable way.

questions.question: What benefit comes to the earth once mountains rise?
questions.answer: The earth gains calmness and can continue its motion without that same level of disruption.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention verses from the Qur’an about mountains?
questions.answer: They are used as support for the idea that mountains are firmly placed to stabilize the earth.

questions.question: After discussing stability, what other role of mountains is highlighted?
questions.answer: Their storing and preserving many useful provisions is highlighted.

questions.question: What does the traveller infer from the wider wisdom seen in mountains and plains?
questions.answer: He understands that they testify to Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention “other duties” and “other instances of wisdom” beyond the two examples?
questions.answer: It suggests the two examples are only part of a much larger pattern of meaning in mountains and plains.

questions.question: Which visible features of mountains and plains especially help the traveller reach this conclusion?
questions.answer: Their wise purposes, their stabilizing role, and the way useful things are stored and managed in them lead him to that conclusion.

questions.question: Who speaks to the traveller at the start of the passage, and what do they ask him to do?
questions.answer: The mountains and plains address him and ask him to read their signs.

questions.question: What does he discover about the mission of mountains?
questions.answer: He discovers that they serve a great and wise purpose in the world.

questions.question: How do mountains relate to disturbances within the earth?
questions.answer: They help ease the effects of those inner disturbances.

questions.question: What change in the earth is described after this stabilizing effect?
questions.answer: The earth becomes tranquil and continues its movement more safely.

questions.question: In the ship example, what role do the masts play?
questions.answer: They help protect the ship from turbulence and keep it balanced.

questions.question: How does the Qur’anic evidence strengthen the point being made?
questions.answer: It shows that revelation also describes mountains as firm stabilizers.

questions.question: How does the passage move from physical facts to spiritual meaning?
questions.answer: It begins with what mountains do in the world and then shows that these ordered benefits point to the Creator.

questions.question: What is the main claim of the final doctrinal statement in this section?
questions.answer: The whole order found in mountains and plains proves the necessary existence and unity of Allah.

questions.question: What new part of creation does the traveller study in this passage?
questions.answer: He studies the mountains and the plains.

questions.question: What do these parts of nature invite him to do?
questions.answer: They invite him to study their signs and lessons.

questions.question: What inner condition of the earth is eased by the appearance of mountains?
questions.answer: Its inner agitation and instability are eased.

questions.question: What image shows the earth becoming relieved because of mountains?
questions.answer: The passage speaks of the earth as if it can breathe more easily.

questions.question: Why is the image of a ship helpful in this passage?
questions.answer: It makes the stabilizing role of mountains easier to understand.

questions.question: What personal response does the traveller make after seeing this?
questions.answer: He says that he believes in Allah.

questions.question: What everyday object is used to help explain the function of mountains?
questions.answer: A ship is used as the example.
